notes_for_consumers.T04_and_readers: Import { loadsStrict, validate, validateJson, canonical, digest, runKey, reportDigest, seal, occurrenceId, normalize, checkSchema, ContractError } from '@inkflip/contracts' (source ESM with .ts specifiers). Python mirror: inkflip.contracts exposes the same names snake_cased via lazy attribute loading; importing inkflip stays dependency-free.
notes_for_consumers.occurrence_identity: occurrenceId(runKey, readerId, pageIndex, ordinal, rawSourceLocator) -> 'o_'+32hex; production readers must generate ids this way; imported readable ids remain schema-valid under v1.
notes_for_consumers.report_identity: seal(report) computes run_key and report_id in place; reportDigest excludes report_id, execution_id, started_at, duration_ms and each asset's data_base64 only.
notes_for_consumers.validation_entry: validateJson(textOrBytes) is the single entry for untrusted bytes: strict parse (duplicate keys, nonfinite/unsafe numbers, surrogates, depth/size) then structural (precompiled) then semantic validation. check_hashes=False exists for tooling that intentionally rewrites digests.
